delta command 1 (y): measured state steps are 0.01x the stored commands (R^2 0.89) - normalization or controller scaling may be intentional; no common-unit contract is established, so this ratio alone is not a conversion-error verdict

checks.title: Deployment readiness (would this dataset serve a policy?)
Stats f32 accumulation fingerprint
checks.summary: per-episode stats carry naive float32 accumulation (10 episode(s))

findings.message: per-episode stats reproduce naive float32 accumulation bitwise (10 sampled episode(s), observation.state dims [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]..., action dims [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]...): the converter's stats are accumulation-rounded, not data-exact; constant channels get a fabricated std and a DC-offset mean
